pictures.title: Harbour at Dusk
pictures.prompt: An impressionist oil painting of a Mediterranean harbour town at sunset. Pastel houses and a tall stone bell tower line the waterfront across the middle of the picture; small fishing boats and sailboats are moored in the calm water across the foreground; the setting sun sits low over distant hills, laying long golden reflections across the rippled water. Thick visible brush strokes and canvas texture.

pictures.title: Dunes at Sundown

pictures.title: Poppies at Sunset

pictures.title: Oranges by Candlelight

Behind them, a warm plastered wall and an open window showing an orange sunset sky over rooftops, so the background is full of detail rather than dark. Fine glazed brushwork.

pictures.title: Blossom Lane

pictures.title: Peonies in a Jug

Loose wet-in-wet washes, granulating pigment, visible paper grain and crisp painted edges.

//destinations: A trip's postcards (lead, 2026-10-25): one real place a board, a picture the size of the whole board (4x4 or 4x5 cards). crop is the col,row of the top-left card of the 2x2 that plays on the board as an ordinary square picture; Levels' maker copies it into the board. name and place are what players read when it unfolds. docs/destinations-america.md lists the candidates.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.checked: against Commons photos of the South Rim near Lipan Point: layered red buttes over the Colorado River's bend, its sandy, green-edged banks, warm low sun
destinations.prompt: The Grand Canyon in Arizona, seen from the South Rim in warm late-afternoon light. In the lower half of the picture, close to the viewer, a great red-orange butte of layered rock bands, its stepped cliffs lit gold with deep blue-purple shadows, and beside it a bend of the green Colorado River far below. Behind it, ridge after ridge of layered canyon walls fading into soft blue haze, under a clear pale blue sky with a few small clouds.

destinations.name: Statue of Liberty
destinations.prompt: The Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor, seen from below and a little to one side on a clear day: the green copper statue large and filling most of the picture, the golden torch held high in her raised right hand, the spiked crown and calm face, the tablet in her left arm, the deep folds of her robe, standing on the top of her grey granite pedestal; a deep blue sky with a few white clouds.

destinations.name: Niagara Falls
destinations.prompt: Niagara Falls: the great curve of the Horseshoe Falls seen from the river below, white water thundering over the green-edged brink into a tall cloud of mist, a bright rainbow arching across the spray, the deep green-blue river swirling in front, a summer blue sky. No boats.

destinations.name: Letchworth State Park
destinations.prompt: The Upper Falls of the Genesee River at Letchworth State Park, New York: a wide waterfall pouring over a stepped rock ledge into a gorge, a tall steel arch railway bridge (one deep steel arch with the deck on top) spanning the gorge high above the falls, steep green wooded cliffs of layered grey shale on both sides, summer, blue sky.

destinations.name: Lucy the Elephant
destinations.prompt: Lucy the Elephant in Margate, New Jersey, seen from the front and side, large and filling the picture: a six-storey building shaped like a standing grey elephant, made of wood and tin, with white tusks, a raised curling trunk, big ears and small windows in its body, a red blanket with gold trim on its back and an ornate canopied howdah on top, on a sandy lot by the beach under a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Mabry Mill
destinations.prompt: An oil painting in the manner of an American plein-air painter: Mabry Mill on the Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia, a small weathered grey-brown wooden gristmill with a big wooden overshot water wheel fed by a long raised wooden flume, reflected in a still millpond, autumn maples in red, orange and gold around it, soft afternoon light.

destinations.name: Castillo de San Marcos
destinations.prompt: Castillo de San Marcos in St. Augustine, Florida: a corner of the old Spanish star-shaped fort of grey coquina shell-stone, a sharp diamond-shaped bastion with a small round stone sentry box with a domed top on its point, seen from the grassy moat below, the thick sloping walls with rough shell-stone texture, palm trees and the blue water of Matanzas Bay beside it, a clear blue sky. No flags.

destinations.name: French Quarter
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken brushstrokes: a street corner in the French Quarter of New Orleans, two pastel townhouses with deep black wrought-iron lace balconies dripping with ferns, hanging baskets and red bougainvillea, tall green shutters, a gas lamp, a few small figures strolling far below, warm afternoon light. No signs.

destinations.name: World's Largest Ball of Twine
destinations.prompt: The world's largest ball of twine in Cawker City, Kansas: a giant round ball of tan sisal twine about eight feet across, large and filling the lower picture, its tightly wound strands clearly visible, sitting on a concrete floor under a small open-sided pavilion with a wooden roof on white posts, a small-town street and a big blue prairie sky behind. No signs, no people.

destinations.name: Paul Bunyan & Babe
destinations.prompt: The giant statues of Paul Bunyan and Babe the Blue Ox in Bemidji, Minnesota, by the lake, large and filling the picture: Paul stands tall on the left, a lumberjack with black hair, a black moustache, a red-and-black buffalo-plaid shirt, blue jeans and black boots, arms at his sides; Babe, a big bright-blue ox with white horns, stands on the right; tall pine trees and the blue lake behind, under a pale sky.

destinations.name: Pictured Rocks
destinations.prompt: Miners Castle at Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore, Michigan: a pale sandstone headland with a single castle-like turret standing out from the cliff over the clear turquoise and green water of Lake Superior, streaks of cream, orange and tan in the rock, dark pine forest on top, a bright summer sky.

destinations.name: Grand Prismatic Spring
destinations.prompt: Grand Prismatic Spring in Yellowstone National Park, seen from the air: a huge round hot spring filling most of the picture, its centre deep blue, ringed by pale green and yellow, then broad bands of orange and rusty red with fine streaks radiating outward across the pale grey mineral ground, a soft drift of steam over one side, a thin boardwalk along the edge. True, natural colours, never neon.

destinations.name: Delicate Arch
destinations.prompt: Delicate Arch in Arches National Park, Utah: a lone free-standing red-orange sandstone arch, large and filling the picture, standing on the rim of a sweeping bowl of bare pink slickrock, the snowy La Sal Mountains blue on the horizon through and beside it, a warm evening sky.

destinations.name: Yosemite Valley
destinations.prompt: Yosemite Valley from Tunnel View, California: the sheer granite face of El Capitan large on the left, Half Dome in the distance at the centre, the white plume of Bridalveil Fall on the cliff on the right, the deep green forest of the valley floor below, a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, late spring.

destinations.name: Nā Pali Coast
destinations.prompt: The Nā Pali Coast on Kauaʻi, Hawaii, seen from the sea: towering green cliffs with sharp fluted ridges dropping straight into the deep blue Pacific, white surf at their feet, a small curve of golden beach, soft white clouds clinging to the peaks.

destinations.checked: the master is mirrored: it came out with the pagoda on the left, and from the Chureito viewpoint Fuji stands left of the pagoda (Commons photos); the prompt now says so
destinations.name: Mount Fuji
destinations.prompt: Mount Fuji seen from the hillside of Arakura Sengen Shrine in Fujiyoshida, Japan, in spring: the five-storey Chureito Pagoda with red-lacquered railings and dark curved roofs in the foreground on the right, framed by pink cherry blossoms, and behind it on the left the snow-capped cone of Mount Fuji, large against a clear blue sky, the town below in soft haze.

destinations.name: Lucky Cat Temple
destinations.prompt: The beckoning cats of Gōtoku-ji temple in Tokyo: one large white maneki-neko cat figurine in the front left, raising its right paw, with a red collar and a small golden bell, and behind it hundreds of smaller white beckoning cats in many sizes packed in rows on wooden shelves against the dark wooden wall of a temple building, green maple leaves above, soft daylight. The figurines are plain white with red and gold details and no writing.

destinations.name: Great Buddha of Kamakura
destinations.prompt: The Great Buddha of Kamakura at Kōtoku-in: the huge seated bronze Buddha, weathered to a soft blue-green with streaks of dark bronze, tightly curled hair, long earlobes, eyes calmly downcast, hands resting in the lap in meditation, seated on a grey stone base in the open air, seen from the front and a little below, large and filling the picture, green trees and a blue sky behind.

destinations.name: Snow Monkey Park
destinations.prompt: Japanese macaques at the Jigokudani hot spring in winter: one red-faced snow monkey with thick grey-brown fur and snowflakes on its head sitting in the steaming water with its eyes closed, large in the foreground, two more grooming each other on the snowy rocks at the pool's edge behind it, dark cedar forest beyond, soft falling snow.

destinations.name: Shirakawa-gō
destinations.prompt: The village of Shirakawa-gō in winter at dusk: three tall gasshō-zukuri farmhouses with steep triangular thatched roofs deep in snow, warm yellow light glowing in their small windows, snowy rice fields in front, dark cedar-covered mountains behind under a deep blue evening sky.

destinations.name: Golden Pavilion
destinations.prompt: Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion in Kyoto, seen across its pond: the three-storey pavilion with its upper two floors covered in gleaming gold leaf and its ground floor of plain dark wood with white panels, dark curved shingle roofs and a small golden phoenix on the peak, standing at the water's edge, reflected in the still Kyōko-chi pond below, small pine-covered islands and rocks in the pond, green pines and maples behind, clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
destinations.prompt: The tunnel of torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, seen from inside: hundreds of bright vermilion wooden torii with black bases and black top beams, set so close together they form a long glowing corridor curving uphill into green forest, dappled sunlight falling across the stone path. The pillars are plain, with no writing on them.

destinations.name: Kiyomizu-dera
destinations.prompt: Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto in autumn: the temple's great wooden main hall with its broad grey cypress-bark roof and the wide wooden stage jutting out from the hillside on a tall lattice of wooden pillars, seen from the side across a valley of blazing red and orange maples, the vermilion three-storey Koyasu pagoda on the wooded hill behind, clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Nachi Falls
destinations.prompt: Nachi Falls in Wakayama, Japan: a single tall white waterfall plunging down a sheer dark cliff in deep green cedar forest, and in front of it on the left the vermilion three-storey pagoda of Seiganto-ji with dark curved roofs, the pagoda and the falls together filling the picture.

destinations.name: Himeji Castle
destinations.prompt: Himeji Castle in Japan: the great white keep rising in tiers of white plastered walls and grey tiled roofs with curving gables, standing on its high sloping stone base, large and filling the picture, pink clouds of cherry blossom at its foot, a pale blue spring sky.

destinations.name: Rabbit Island
destinations.prompt: Wild rabbits on Ōkunoshima, the rabbit island in Japan's Inland Sea: a fluffy brown rabbit sitting up on its hind legs on short green grass, large and close in the foreground, more rabbits of brown, grey and white nibbling the lawn behind it, a pine tree and the calm blue sea with small green islands beyond, a sunny day.

destinations.name: Itsukushima Shrine
destinations.prompt: The great vermilion O-torii gate of Itsukushima Shrine standing in the sea off Miyajima at high tide: its two thick main pillars braced by four smaller legs, the black curved top beam, large and filling the picture, calm blue water reflecting it, green forested Mount Misen behind, a soft evening sky. The plaque on the gate is blank.

destinations.name: Kintai Bridge
destinations.prompt: Kintai Bridge in Iwakuni, Japan: five graceful wooden arches in a row across the wide, clear Nishiki River on tall stone piers, in the lower half of the picture, cherry trees in bloom along the far bank, and the small white Iwakuni Castle on top of the green wooded mountain behind, blue sky.

destinations.name: Takachiho Gorge
destinations.prompt: Takachiho Gorge in Miyazaki, Japan, seen from the river: the slender white Manai Falls dropping from the top of a narrow gorge of dark basalt columns overhung with bright green trees, into a still jade-green river where a few small empty wooden rowboats float, summer light.

destinations.name: Taketomi Island
destinations.prompt: Taketomi Island in Okinawa: a water buffalo harnessed to a little wooden cart with a red-tiled roof, standing on a lane of white coral sand between low walls of grey coral stones topped with red and pink bougainvillea and hibiscus, traditional one-storey houses with red clay tile roofs behind, a small shisa lion figure on one roof, blue sky. The cart is empty.

destinations.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo
destinations.prompt: The Tre Cime di Lavaredo in the Dolomites, seen from the north at golden hour: three enormous pale grey rock towers standing side by side, the middle one the tallest, rising above a scree slope and green alpine meadows with a small path, a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Seceda
destinations.prompt: The Seceda ridge above Val Gardena in the Dolomites: a vast green grassy slope rising to a sharp knife-edge of jagged grey rock spires that drops away sheer on the far side, a small wooden hay hut on the meadow, a blue sky with a few white clouds.

destinations.name: Lake Como
destinations.prompt: The village of Varenna on Lake Como: tall ochre, rose and terracotta houses with green shutters stepping down to the deep blue lake, a slender bell tower among them, a stone waterfront with little wooden boats, green mountains rising behind.

destinations.name: Isola Bella
destinations.prompt: A pure white peacock with its white tail fanned wide open, standing on a stone balustrade in the baroque terraced garden of Isola Bella on Lake Maggiore, the peacock large in the picture, clipped green hedges behind and the blue lake beyond.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken brushstrokes: a quiet canal in Venice in soft morning light, a black gondola moored beside striped wooden poles, old palazzi with faded pink and ochre walls, arched windows and flower boxes rising straight from green water, a small stone footbridge in the distance. No famous landmarks.

destinations.name: Cinque Terre
destinations.prompt: Manarola in the Cinque Terre at golden hour: tall pastel houses in red, yellow, pink and peach stacked up a dark rocky sea cliff, little boats pulled up on the slipway at the bottom, the deep blue Ligurian Sea below. No boat names.

destinations.name: Burano
destinations.prompt: Burano near Venice: a row of small houses painted vivid blue, red, yellow, green and pink along a narrow canal, white window frames, little boats moored at the edge, the bright colours reflected in the still water.

destinations.name: The Cheese Cathedral
destinations.prompt: Inside a Parmigiano cheese ageing warehouse in Emilia: towering wooden shelves stacked to the ceiling with hundreds of big golden wheels of cheese in long receding rows, warm light. The rinds are plain, with no markings or writing.

destinations.name: Val d'Orcia
destinations.prompt: The Val d'Orcia in Tuscany: a pale road zigzagging up a green hill lined with rows of tall dark cypress trees, a stone farmhouse at the top, rolling green and golden hills around.

destinations.name: Civita di Bagnoregio
destinations.prompt: Civita di Bagnoregio in Lazio: a small medieval stone village perched on top of a steep crumbling clay pinnacle, reached by a long narrow footbridge rising from the foreground, deep eroded grey gullies and green valleys around, soft morning mist.

destinations.name: Monster Park
destinations.prompt: The Monster Park of Bomarzo: a giant moss-covered stone ogre head carved from a boulder, its huge gaping mouth a doorway you could walk into, wild staring eyes, among green woodland, large and filling the picture. No writing on it.

destinations.name: Positano
destinations.prompt: Positano on the Amalfi Coast: pastel houses in peach, pink and white tumbling down a steep cliff to a small beach with rows of orange umbrellas, the green-and-yellow tiled dome of its church among the houses, the deep blue sea.

destinations.name: The Faraglioni
destinations.prompt: The Faraglioni of Capri: three huge pale limestone sea stacks rising from deep blue water off a green cliff, the middle one pierced by a natural arch with a small white boat passing through it.

destinations.name: Matera
destinations.prompt: An oil painting: the Sassi of Matera at dusk, an ancient town of pale stone cave houses and small churches stacked up the side of a rocky ravine, warm lights in their windows, the deep ravine below, a blue evening sky.

destinations.name: Alberobello
destinations.prompt: The trulli of Alberobello in Puglia: rows of small whitewashed stone cottages with grey cone-shaped stone roofs topped with little white pinnacles, along a narrow lane climbing a hill, red geraniums in pots by the doors.

destinations.name: Bixby Bridge
destinations.prompt: Bixby Bridge on Big Sur in California: a soaring single arch of pale concrete with tall slender columns above it, spanning a deep canyon where it meets the Pacific, the coastal highway on top, green-gold cliffs and white surf below, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Emerald Bay
destinations.prompt: Emerald Bay on Lake Tahoe seen from the slopes above: a curving bay of brilliant green-blue water with tiny Fannette Island in the middle, ringed by steep pine-covered slopes, the deep blue lake beyond, grey granite mountains.

destinations.name: Mono Lake
destinations.prompt: The tufa towers of Mono Lake at sunrise: knobbly pale limestone towers rising from still lake water and mirrored in it, snowy Sierra Nevada mountains far behind, a pink and blue sky.

destinations.name: Joshua Tree
destinations.prompt: Joshua Tree National Park in California: one tall spiky Joshua tree with twisting arms in front of a pile of giant round tan granite boulders, the open desert floor, a pink sunset sky.

destinations.name: Oatman's Burros
destinations.prompt: A wild burro in Oatman, Arizona, an old Route 66 gold-rush town: a shaggy grey-brown burro with long ears standing in the dusty main street beside the wooden porch of an old false-front building, a second burro behind, dry hills under a blue sky. No signs or writing anywhere.

destinations.name: Horseshoe Bend
destinations.prompt: Horseshoe Bend in Arizona seen from the rim: the green Colorado River curving in a horseshoe loop around a tall red sandstone tower far below, sheer red cliffs, the pale rock rim in the foreground, late afternoon light.

destinations.name: Zion Narrows
destinations.prompt: The Narrows in Zion National Park, Utah: a shallow green river flowing between soaring sheer walls of red and orange sandstone only a few metres apart, glowing with reflected light, a strip of sky far above.

destinations.name: Bryce Canyon
destinations.prompt: Bryce Canyon in Utah: an amphitheatre of tall thin orange and pink rock spires (hoodoos) with pale tops, green pines on the rim, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Valley of Fire
destinations.prompt: The Fire Wave in Valley of Fire State Park, Nevada: a rounded dome of sandstone swirled with curving bands of pink, red and cream like a candy stripe, red rock fins around, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Grand Teton
destinations.prompt: Mormon Row in Grand Teton National Park, Wyoming: an old weathered grey wooden barn with a steep roof standing in a sagebrush meadow, the jagged snowy Teton peaks rising behind it, soft morning light.

destinations.name: Palouse Falls
destinations.prompt: Palouse Falls in Washington: a single waterfall plunging into a round turquoise pool in a deep bowl of dark basalt cliffs, golden grass on the rim, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Teapot Dome Station
destinations.prompt: The Teapot Dome Service Station in Zillah, Washington: a small 1920s gas station built in the shape of a giant white teapot with a red handle and spout and a round lid for its roof, an old petrol pump in front, under a blue sky. No writing anywhere.

destinations.name: Painted Hills
destinations.prompt: The Painted Hills in Oregon: soft rounded hills striped in bands of red, gold, ochre and black, sparse green shrubs at their feet, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Dog Bark Park Inn
destinations.prompt: Dog Bark Park Inn in Cottonwood, Idaho: a two-storey guesthouse built in the shape of a giant brown-and-cream beagle sitting on a green lawn, with windows in its body and a little balcony under its chin, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Crater Lake
destinations.prompt: Crater Lake in Oregon: a vast lake of deep sapphire blue filling a volcano's crater, ringed by steep grey cliffs, the cone of Wizard Island rising from the water near the edge, pines on the rim in the foreground, snow on the far rim.

destinations.name: The cliffs of Étretat
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken, dabbed brushstrokes: the Falaise d'Aval at Étretat in Normandy, tall white chalk cliffs topped with green grass, a great natural arch stepping out into the sea and a slender pointed needle of rock standing offshore beside it, a curving pebble beach, green-blue sea with small white waves, a breezy summer sky. Never a copy of a real painting.

destinations.name: Mont-Saint-Michel
destinations.prompt: Mont-Saint-Michel in Normandy at golden hour, seen from the flats: a granite rock island rising from wet, shining tidal sand, its ramparts and stone village houses climbing to the great Gothic abbey church on the summit with its tall slender spire topped by a small golden statue, a pale blue sky.

destinations.name: The pink granite coast
destinations.prompt: The pink granite coast at Ploumanac'h in Brittany: giant smooth rounded boulders of rose-pink granite piled along the shore, a small square lighthouse built of the same pink granite blocks among them, purple heather and yellow gorse, a calm blue-green sea, soft evening light.

destinations.name: The chapel oak of Allouville
destinations.prompt: The Chêne chapelle of Allouville-Bellefosse in Normandy: an enormous ancient hollow oak with a vast gnarled trunk, patched in places with grey wooden shingles, a small pointed shingled steeple rising from its top among the leafy branches, a wooden staircase with a handrail spiralling up around the trunk to a little door into the tree, a village lawn, summer light.

destinations.name: Château de Chenonceau
destinations.prompt: Château de Chenonceau in the Loire Valley: an elegant white stone Renaissance château with grey slate roofs and pointed turrets, its long gallery built right across the river Cher on a row of graceful arches, reflected in the calm water, green trees on both banks, a soft summer sky.

destinations.name: The Eiffel Tower
destinations.prompt: The Eiffel Tower in Paris on a bright sunny day, seen from the Champ de Mars: the whole tower from its four great arched legs to its slender tip, standing tall in the middle of the picture, its warm bronze-brown iron lattice crisp against a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, green lawns and trees at its feet. Daylight only, no lights.

destinations.name: Colmar's Little Venice
destinations.prompt: La Petite Venise in Colmar, Alsace: a row of tall half-timbered houses painted bright yellow, pink, blue and green with dark timber frames and red-brown tiled roofs, window boxes overflowing with red geraniums, leaning over a calm canal full of reflections, a small flat wooden boat moored under a willow. No shop signs or writing.

destinations.name: Mont Blanc from Lac Blanc
destinations.prompt: Lac Blanc above Chamonix on an early summer morning: a small still alpine lake among grey rocks and patches of snow, perfectly mirroring the snowy, jagged Mont Blanc massif across the valley, its glaciers and sharp needle peaks, a clear deep blue sky.

destinations.name: Palais Idéal du Facteur Cheval
destinations.prompt: Le Palais Idéal du Facteur Cheval in Hauterives, Drôme: a fantastical palace hand-built of cemented pebbles and stones, its façade crowded with sculpted towers, arches, grottoes, palm-trunk columns, animals and three tall stone giants, all in warm grey and ochre stone, a lawn and shrubs in front, a blue sky. No inscriptions or carved words.

destinations.name: The lavender of Valensole
destinations.prompt: The lavender fields of the Valensole plateau in Provence in July: long straight rows of purple lavender running into the distance towards a lone old stone farmhouse and a single round tree, a strip of golden wheat beyond, a soft blue sky.

destinations.name: The Gorges du Verdon
destinations.prompt: The Gorges du Verdon in Provence on a sunny day, seen from above: a deep limestone canyon with sheer pale cliffs and green scrub, a milky turquoise river winding along the bottom, a few small kayaks on the water.

destinations.name: The flamingos of the Camargue
destinations.prompt: Greater flamingos in a shallow lagoon of the Camargue in southern France: one pale pink flamingo close up wading in the foreground, dozens more pink flamingos standing and feeding in the calm silver-blue water behind it, reeds and a low flat horizon, soft morning light.

destinations.name: Carcassonne
destinations.prompt: La Cité de Carcassonne: the medieval walled city on its hill, double rings of honey-coloured stone ramparts and dozens of round towers with pointed grey slate cone roofs, rows of green vines in the foreground, a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Bonifacio
destinations.prompt: Bonifacio in Corsica on a bright day: tall white and cream limestone cliffs worn into horizontal layers by the sea, the old town's tall houses perched right on the cliff edge high above a deep turquoise and blue sea, a small white boat far below.

destinations.name: The Dune du Pilat
destinations.prompt: The Dune du Pilat near Arcachon in late afternoon light: a vast golden sand dune with a sharp curving ridge, a dark green pine forest stretching away on one side and the blue Atlantic with pale sandbanks on the other, a few tiny walkers on the ridge.

destinations.name: Moraine Lake
destinations.prompt: Moraine Lake in Banff National Park: a vivid turquoise glacial lake below the Valley of the Ten Peaks, a wall of jagged grey mountain peaks streaked with snow, dark green spruce forest along the shore, a jumble of rocks in the foreground, a clear sky. No canoes.

destinations.name: Abraham Lake's frozen bubbles
destinations.prompt: Abraham Lake in Alberta in winter: stacks of round white bubbles frozen at different depths in clear dark blue-black ice, seen close up from above in the foreground, the frozen lake running away to snowy mountains in the distance, cold clear light.

destinations.name: The giant pysanka
destinations.prompt: The giant pysanka of Vegreville, Alberta: an enormous Ukrainian Easter egg sculpture on a tall pedestal, its surface built of flat bronze, gold and silver tiles in a geometric pattern of interlocking stars, triangles and stripes, a small grassy park around it, a big blue prairie sky. No text.

destinations.name: Mac the Moose
destinations.prompt: Mac the Moose in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan: a giant ten-metre statue of a dark brown bull moose standing tall with a huge spread of pale antlers, on a grassy roadside park, seen from slightly below against a big blue prairie sky with white clouds. No text or signs.

destinations.name: The northern lights
destinations.prompt: The northern lights over Great Slave Lake near Yellowknife: bright green and violet aurora curtains swirling across a dark star-filled sky, above a snowy frozen lake and a dark line of spruce trees, drawn on dark blue paper.

destinations.name: Parliament Hill
destinations.prompt: Parliament Hill in Ottawa seen from across the Ottawa River on a sunny summer day: the Gothic Revival parliament buildings of pale sandstone with steep green copper roofs and the tall Peace Tower in the middle, standing along the top of a steep wooded cliff above the wide blue river, the buildings spread across the middle of the picture from left to right, a blue sky with white clouds. The clock face small, no readable numbers or writing.

destinations.name: The polar bears of Churchill
destinations.prompt: A polar bear on the shore of Hudson Bay near Churchill, Manitoba: a big cream-white polar bear standing on smooth grey rocks dusted with snow, close up, a second bear resting behind it, the first sea ice forming on the grey bay, soft overcast light. No vehicles.

destinations.name: Old Quebec in winter
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: Old Quebec City at winter dusk, the Château Frontenac with its steep copper-green roofs, turrets and tall central tower rising above the snow-covered roofs of the old town, the icy St Lawrence River beside it, warm lights glowing in the windows, softly falling snow. No signs or writing.

destinations.name: Percé Rock
destinations.prompt: Percé Rock off the Gaspé Peninsula in Quebec on a sunny day: a huge long ship-shaped limestone rock rising sheer from the sea, pierced by a great natural arch at its seaward end, layered in ochre, orange and grey, the deep blue Gulf of St Lawrence around it, a pebble beach in the foreground.

destinations.name: The gannets of Bonaventure
destinations.prompt: Northern gannets on Bonaventure Island in Quebec: one white gannet close up in profile, its pale yellow head, pale blue-ringed eye and black wingtips, with thousands more gannets packed together on the cliff top behind it, the blue sea far below.

destinations.name: The Hopewell Rocks
destinations.prompt: The Hopewell Rocks in the Bay of Fundy at low tide: tall reddish-brown flowerpot sea stacks of eroded rock, narrow at the base and topped with small fir trees, standing on the wet sea floor, a few tiny people walking between them, the cliffs behind.

destinations.name: Peggy's Cove lighthouse
destinations.prompt: Peggy's Cove lighthouse in Nova Scotia: a white octagonal lighthouse with a red lantern room standing on smooth, rounded pale granite rocks, Atlantic waves breaking white below, a soft blue sky.

destinations.name: Lunenburg
destinations.prompt: The waterfront of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia: a row of big old wooden harbour warehouses painted bright barn red with white trim, and one ochre-yellow, along the wharf, mirrored in the calm harbour, the mast of a wooden schooner and small boats, the colourful town climbing the hill behind. No signs, names or writing.

destinations.name: The Cabot Trail in autumn
destinations.prompt: The Cabot Trail on Cape Breton Island in autumn: a winding road curving along a high coast through rolling hills blazing red, orange and gold with maples and birches, the deep blue sea beside it, a clear sky.

destinations.name: The icebergs of Twillingate
destinations.prompt: A huge iceberg drifting off Twillingate, Newfoundland on a bright clear day: a towering white iceberg with sculpted peaks and glowing blue cracks floating in a dark blue sea, a small fishing village of colourful wooden houses on the rocky shore in the foreground.
